component.name: SketchSmith
component.summary: Sketch ideas in 3D and hand them off

description.p: SketchSmith is a light, precise 3D sketching application for Linux in the spirit of SketchUp's push-and-pull modelling. Draw an idea quickly with inference snapping and typed dimensions, then hand it off to Blender, a slicer, CAD software, or a dimensioned drawing for a builder.

ul.li: Draw edges and faces; extrude them, along paths too; loft, revolve and skin them
Move, rotate, scale, bevel, fuse, knife and repair geometry
Paint, label, dimension and section models
Export to OBJ, STL, glTF, 3MF, STEP, DXF, PDF, SVG and PNG
Import OBJ, STL, DAE, SVG, glTF and 3MF files
Open SketchUp .skp files (2013 to 2020) with their groups, components, layers, paint, guides and labels
Keymaps: SketchSmith, SketchUp, Blender or your own

description.p: SketchSmith is not affiliated with or endorsed by Trimble. "SketchUp" is used only to name a file format SketchSmith can read.

ul.li: Drawing, modify, tweak, generate, measure and repair tools
Paint, labels, dimensions and section planes
Export to OBJ, STL, glTF, 3MF, STEP, DXF, PDF, SVG and PNG
Import OBJ, STL, DAE, SVG, glTF and 3MF; open SketchUp .skp files (2013 to 2020)
Keymaps: SketchSmith, SketchUp, Blender or your own
